title: Gomen Be Sega (Ethiopian Greens Stew)
description: A flavorful and nutritious Ethiopian greens stew made with tender greens and a rich, smoky sauce. Serve with injera bread for a traditional meal.

ingredients.name: lovely greens
ingredients.notes: such as collard or mustard greens

ingredients.name: smoky berbere spice
ingredients.notes: or substitute with a combination of chili powder and paprika

instructions: Heat oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add onion and garlic, sauté until softened.
Add berbere spice and cook for 1 minute.
Add greens and gomen, stir to combine.
Add water, bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer, covered, for 20-25 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
